# Space Mono (static, regular + bold, latin subset)

Downloaded from Google Fonts' `css2` API (`family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700`), latin-subset
`@font-face` blocks, with a desktop-Chrome user agent. Space Mono has no variable-font release,
so this is two static files (400 and 700) rather than one variable one. Vendored locally for the
same CSP reason as `vendor/fonts/manrope/`. Used for the marketing-site neo-brutalist redesign —
mono labels/badges ("HIGH PRIORITY", nav tags) — not the app itself, which already has its own
vendored JetBrains Mono for the same role.

License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (per Google Fonts).
